Instead, some of you householders (*Grihasthashramis*)—mostly it is the poor who say this—say with great arrogance, "Whatever happens, I have fulfilled my duty." What is it? Had a daughter and married her off. This is his karma! What is the use of this fool who thinks that everything is completed with this? No. I spoke wrongly. They did not see that it is only a part of their karma. Looking after one's father and mother. That is a part of his karma. Loving the neighbors. Welcoming guests. All these are his karma. Then what is it? The duty of a householder (*Grihadharma*) is the duty of taking one's soul to the Guru, purifying the soul through the Guru, and making it reach the state of Brahman. He does not understand this. He just wants to become worthless somehow. That is such a filthy way of karma. That is why I said, this is why God has given us this attire.

[GV4:P0875] How should the ascetic (*Sanyasi*) that we need be? Growing up, even if that is not possible for him, he should at least fulfill the duties of a householder (*Grihasthashramadharma*). What is that? The duty of the home (*Grihadharma*), duty to ancestors (*Pitridharma*), duty to deities (*Devadharma*), duty of charity (*Danadharma*), and duty to the Self (*Atmadharma*). Then, whichever deities his ancestors or predecessors have been worshipping—he must become a householder capable of granting them liberation. Thus, men and women become the mother and father of the world. That is what is called 'Mata Pita Guru Daivam' (Mother, Father, Preceptor, God). So, we are struggling completely to bring them into such a karma. What is it? This dharma called karmic potential (*Karmashesi*) is a Truth served to the human world—you must fulfill that dharma. You need not fulfill it by merely talking about asceticism (*Sanyasa*). You must attain fulfillment through life completely, take up absolute knowledge as Guru and lineage, and impart the fulfillment of that action to the children. This is exactly what we intend by our *Brahmaniveditham*. You should not assume that they are all going to become ascetics. It is not like that. We should create the aspect of knowledge for them. Those who are destined will become that. What is the use of him if he does not become at least a good householder? Or what is the use of this woman? Now, in the name of being a good householder, there is a house wherever one goes. It would be like making one for the sake of renunciation. That is, a toddy tapper will have women and men in many places. Wherever he goes, there will be a marriage. Similarly, in the olden days, the great uncle would also have many marriages. We absolutely do not want a householder life like this. We must explain this to our children. That is why the ritual called Gurupooja is conducted here. Then we should tell them, children, it is like this—we did not get this. In your young age, a Guru lineage has come into existence in such a way as to make you understand what an ancestor (*Pitru*) is, what a deity (*Deva*) is, what a sage (*Rishi*) is, what a wise one (*Jnani*) is, and what a devotee (*Bhakta*) is. Here, you must fulfill this completely, dear child. You just need to do that much for us. You don't have to do anything else. Just save us. That means, whatever position this child reaches, that same position is attained by the father and mother. So, by nurturing it like this, for our third generation, you will see children growing up without being suffocated like this. Through you, this is being donated to the world. What is being shown is a small beginning of that.

[GV4:P0876] Words of the Guru (*Guruvani*)

[GV4:P0877] Santhigiri Janmadina Poojitha Dedicated Edition 2003

[GV4:P0878] Dialogue between the Guru and the Disciple

[GV4:P0879] Disciple: Does saying these nine planets mean nine steps?

[GV4:P0880] Guru:- Nine states. You could say steps, if needed. That is nine skies. As being entitled to this, what they say in the Trinity (*Trimurti*) is twenty-seven stars, now for the Earth and the planets revolving around it. At the same time, we see millions of stars. All these are different descriptions. That is, these stars are individual souls. So, this is what they say, what is it? This Yogi. Nothing. *Neti, Neti, Neti* (Not this, Not this, Not this), the Vedantin. Merging and merging, he just ceases to exist. He is not merging away. He merged to the extent he grew. That is all. Then he became independent and left. Now the Yogi, having become independent, will just shine from there and remain there. There is no Guru.

[GV4:P0881] Disciple:- Would the twenty-seven stars be great supreme souls (*Mahatmas*)?

[GV4:P0882] Guru: That is the concept of Brahman (Brahmasankalpam). A Rishi, Sanyasi, Yogi, Jnani, Bhakta, and Karmi, one who has passed through like this, a perfected Guru. Each of these is a perfected star. Haven't many come like this since the world began? The one who enacts all this and departs is the one who comes as this Guru of the ages (Kalantara Guru). All this belongs to him. Otherwise, no one can go. These people lie like this ٹ That is why the frog is given as an example - the frog in the well.

[GV4:P0883] So, one comes as the inheritor of an era (yuga). Now, don't they say - constellations. Because they stand here, when they go there, it is not there. Isn't this what they say? They are not fortunate enough to reach there. Then with what are they going to discover it? They cannot, and then they will say it does not exist. When they go there, they are not there. It is a period of many crores of years. Its time is over and it has become complete. Then one became the inheritor of a solar system. Only these twenty-seven stars will come. The others have no name. We see many stars now. It has taken many crores of years to reach our eyes. Only these twenty-seven stars are included in this calculation. That is the decree of Brahman (Brahmanischayam). One will see it to the extent of its vastness. Understood? A person came in the measure of a manvantara. Only that person can speak about the twenty-seven stars. Did you understand? So, there are twenty-seven stars within this one solar system.

[GV4:P0884] Disciple:- The stars other than these twenty-seven are stars not according to the decree of Brahman. It was said they won't be seen when they go there. Are they taking birth or are they getting destroyed?

[GV4:P0885] Guru:- They will stay and get destroyed. Some are grieving and doing penance from there, thinking, "I could not do anything."

[GV4:P0886] Disciple:- A star would have its own time period, wouldn't it?

[GV4:P0887] Guru:- Yes, it will. When it leaves a sky within a solar system, it changes. There are these twenty-seven centralized stars, right? The zodiac signs (rashis) of those twenty-seven stars are twelve. And nine planets. Once a life attains this, it will change. None of the others (stars) will attain it. Not a single one will attain it. These two thousand, three thousand, four thousand will not remain. It will stay for the time it is spoken of. Then it will go.

[GV4:P0888] Disciple:- Then Carlos is asking how it comes down.

[GV4:P0889] Guru:- You should observe and understand that. It is not something to be known by asking. You just see where the Guru stands like that. Otherwise, it is not something to be told.

[GV4:P0890] Disciple:- That means the gods and goddesses and stars above us will change. They will change by themselves.

[GV4:P0891] Guru:- Those are all different states. There is no need for us to mention all that. All that should be discarded. That is their concern. Why should we talk about it? In every way, the calculation is the same. But when it changes like this and each sky changes, now the earth is connected with the twenty-seven stars, twelve zodiac signs, and the nine planets. Once this life reaches this much, it will not come again. Brahman keeps it aside there. It is Brahman itself. It will be seen in all life. It is merging. When it is said it is kept aside, it means it is kept merged. When the required time comes, Brahman will bring it back again. Haven't you heard what Aravindan says? That he went and brought it back.

[GV4:P0892] So, it comes as twenty-seven great souls (Mahatmas) for these twenty-seven stars.

[GV4:P0893] Disciple:- When that one coming soul is sent as Brahman itself, does a set belonging to that soul come here?

[GV4:P0894] Guru:- Yes, it comes. It does not come always. No one can know how it is decided by Brahman. When one goes by calculation, one goes wrong. That is why it is said that science goes wrong.

[GV4:P0895] Disciple: So, will those who come along also be perfect like this?

[GV4:P0896] Guru: Why should we know whether it is so? Didn't I tell you to observe and understand! Isn't it a job that misleads people? We should not say any of this publicly. Now, because you asked like this, I told you. So, once you grasp the power of one star, you will see all that. Thus, after seeing these twelve zodiac signs, the zodiac signs will come according to the calculation of these twenty-seven stars. Yes, it is the decree of Brahman. We don't have to look into any of that. Just say what was shown to us. That is the Guru and the disciple, we must always hold on like this. Otherwise, if you tie and wrap all this up like a bundle, it will just sit there. Aren't they showing mystical powers (siddhis)? If they don't go properly, they will not be able to show even the matter of these siddhis within this manvantara or this chaturyuga. They will just lie there. They won't be saved. How, why will they be saved from there? An evidence of that is Sathya Sai now. It is said he climbed six steps. It is true, the position of a Deva. Going there, they grasp all these Devas and turn them into siddhis. All those who showed these siddhis must do sit-ups (etham) in front of Brahman. Isn't etham done holding like this? So, each birth is for this one etham.

[GV4:P0897] Now, when Jesus's disciples scooped up water, wasn't there a depression there? What is the use? There will be a depression in the water equal to what was scooped. If you scoop a handful of water from the sea, just because it gets depressed that much, will the water run out? That scooping means he will only see as far as his vision goes. How much will be visible to his eye? There is no point in talking big things. We don't need all this. You hold on to the Guru. Let what is attained be attained.

[GV4:P0898] Disciple: The world began from seven Sanyasis. It was a Rishi sitting among them who conducted all this.

[GV4:P0899] Guru: Yes. There is such a story. But we shouldn't hold onto it permanently. How do we know how the divine will (Brahmanishchayam) unfolds? We shouldn't say anything beyond that. So, whoever we see, we must speak of them. Everything exists. It is true. Fine, your mind only reaches that far, what can I do! Besides, do not tell him just to prove what we say is right. According to our knowledge - didn't you (Carlos) say that you were with the Guru for so many lifetimes? That itself will be useful to you in certain situations. Sometimes it won't be useful. You might not see anything. Sometimes you will get scolded. Sometimes you will get beaten. Sometimes you will get something else good. Sometimes you will be given grapes. Sometimes you will be given dog feces. We are not establishing authority by oppressing anything. We must grasp it ourselves and become the authority. This is the word in it. One will grow on one's own through action.

[GV4:P0900] In the justice of God, they are being trampled underfoot. They are that vile. If we start trying to reform them, the world will not improve. And they are not acting this way to become better, either. They only want to accumulate as much violent tendency as possible. You might ask why God nurtures such vile practices. Doesn't God know? Can't God just close an eye or open an eye? You should not harbor such disgraceful ignorance. God does not stand by to open or close his eyes just because you or I say so. If there is such a special power, what is being spoken of is the philosophical perspective of the valor of action, which knows how this course of dharma was brought into this world. Who here can bestow such a philosophical vision upon them? It is never possible. They are the flawed performers of action (karmadoshis) who create a world of vile deeds. No one can reform them. What can stop the children of these people afflicted by the flaws of action? What will they hold within themselves? What have these people achieved other than being wretches who play with father, mother, children, husband, wife, wealth, dominance, and knowledge, and ultimately perish? If you take up and perform such filthy actions, who will stand by this flaw of action? Think! Think about the times of every birth and death. Your children get diseases, parents get diseases, gurus get diseases, and their disciples are killed off. Who can justify this ignorance that rules by destroying everyone? Who will take it where? What will the progeny of those afflicted by flawed karma achieve here? Think about it. Even if you destroy the world, you cannot escape from that action. The world only exists as long as this earth remains, right? This solar system can only do so much. There are thousands of solar systems like this. Scientists you see in the future will tell you. But they only want to say it; what they comprehend are things that happened in light-years or at some time in the past. Where will they end up? Which world are they setting out for? It is doubtful whether a single religious scholar or a single believer thinks about this. If all this is taken, measured, weighed, and given to do good for the world and humanity, it is only good for imposing on the heads of some poor people, causing their intellect to develop just enough to blaspheme God. Beyond that, they can do nothing. You must consider what this human world, which imparts such ignorance, should do. All the children in the world should consider it. It is of no use if only one or two people, or one caste or religion, think about it. The foundation of ignorance that proves that many people who develop their intellect like this and various violent individuals dying off is 'samadhi'! How can this be uprooted and planted elsewhere? Where will it be planted? Think! Every one of you is a mischievous being unable to see or respect even a fraction of what these great men and prophets suffered. The proof of this is the burial practices (kabaradakkam) copied from the stones in the yard to the stones in the forest, bringing them to the temple and the church, and taking it from there. If the core of such profound ignorance is snatched and kept in your hands, what can you do to this world? Not a single child can do anything. For that, there is a language nurtured as the progeny of each prophet: the Vaidikan, or the Tantri, or the Mantri, Yantri, Kuntri—all this is a mixture of all these together. If you do not stop this work, it would be better to put a knife to the necks of the children of all these people who act this way. You shouldn't raise them just to kill them. Kill them as soon as they are born.

[GV4:P0901] In some places, if they see it's a girl, they will finish her off immediately. You all know this. So, in this world, who can do anything to you or your children, who hold the axe of this vile deed in your hands, brimming with offense and taking pleasure in this ignorance that serves and destroys with such 'knowledge'? Think! It is never to achieve this. The excess you do to your own life by getting caught in this transitional phase will absolutely lead to a birth that God will never permit. This is what is going to happen. Who can control the children of vile deeds? Having a little money and using it to wage religious wars, seeing that and waging caste wars, retrieving the flaws of action—how will you reform the oracles of such caste mischief? Think! I am only saying this much now. It is fine whether you think about it or not. It is fine whether you give anything to the world or not. Having spoken this truth to you, I will have no difficulty leaving this country or this world. The word of truth—you cannot destroy those words. They will not be destroyed if set on fire, they will not rot in water, they cannot be shattered by thunder and rain. You will be born as the very basic natures of absolutely complete flawed action. God will not let you go in any way. If you consciously perform action and fail, no one can hold you back. Who can destroy, and how, this action that has been corrupted by what is suppressed by the Vaidikans and Sanyasis, mentioned in the foundational texts like Manusmriti or something else? But it will be destroyed like this. A flaw of action where not even a speck of rust can hide in this world is a truth that none of you can ever set aside. For the sake of this action, by making you perform Guru Pooja and having it performed—not for any caste or religion. Not to remove any flaw of action. For the growth of your children; to prevent vile karma from joining their progeny, and to give liberation to ancestors or prophets if they somehow fell into error. Not to reform these so-called pseudo-nationalists. It is fine if they improve, and fine if they perish. Let them go their way. This word will be the truth, forever. Remember!

[GV4:P0902] Now, I am telling you about the magnitude of the virtues and vices that we and our ancestors have accumulated up to this day. Otherwise, contemplate what you will become if you fail to attain the merit that comes through prayer here and the blessings granted by God, which grow and multiply through you. Those standing inside and outside know this in many ways. You must think, act, and apply this in your life's path, preserving without losing this dharma given by God to pass on to your children. It is not you or I who should measure the fruit and fulfillment of your prayers thus far. I can only convey the words I receive to you. It is you—father, mother, children, husband, and wife—who must understand and act upon them. Without letting it decay into mere wealth, dominance, and worldly knowledge, what I have explained is the weight of the traditional wisdom of children, where every single atom transforms into seeds to do dharma for the world. You should embrace it if you are capable of doing so. Isn't that so? God has shown all this to you. Today, most believers—by believers, do not assume it means only the believers here, but believers anywhere, belonging to any Guru lineage—are receiving proof of this. They will pass it on to the children to come. Understanding this, everyone should complete their lives with happiness. This is all I have to say.

[GV4:P0903] You should never discard through flaws that dharma, comprising the good and the bad, which God has served and integrated into your being; preserve it with goodness.

You should see this as a God-given path to bring about a change in the sinful and virtuous karmas of the soul, much like a tree sprouting and bearing fruit, preserving the complementary nature of the Earth, Moon, and Sun. It cannot be compared to any other ashram or system of worship. Traditional growth will occur through a girl who adheres to the truth.

If good progeny beneficial to the home and the land are not attained, the family will be ruined. Through your life, you can attain this only through virtuous children.

[GV4:P0917] Guruvani

[GV4:P0918] Santhigiri Janmadinapoojitha Dedication Issue 2003

[GV4:P0919] It is known through experience that Kali is good, not bad

[GV4:P0920] We all believe that there is a time limit for everything. However, it should be seen as a flaw that we have fallen into due to this Trimurti system, to the extent that we are unable to recognize what the dharma of Kali is. What is it? Speaking of our history, it is through the Trimurtis that we have been guided and protected. Do not assume that this Trimurti status does not exist; it does. Looking at it that way, nothing that has come up to this day is non-existent. But how do we change it? How can it be changed? Until now, anyone has only been able to dismiss it through words. No one has been able to embrace it. Then, Narayana Guru is also seen saying something like this:

[GV4:P0921] The lamp that shines forth when the triad is destroyed

[GV4:P0922] Cannot be attained by a false ascetic.

[GV4:P0923] That is correct. How this *triputi* (threefold state) will conclude is indeed a profound subject that we must fully understand. That is Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, or Shaktheya, Shaiva, Vaishnava—this is a truth that our ancestors practiced and established. How can one say it does not exist? It certainly exists. However, although it mentions in a few words what should be done with that which exists, it is not quite like that. The aspect referred to as its knowledge is the great result of karma, executed and consolidated from within this earth, or similarly, this new age, or this new sphere. How can we reclaim it from this? It is not possible at all. The reason is not only that such a vast vision cannot be perceived, but even if it were, how and by whom could it be utilized? It is completely impossible. That is its significant peculiarity. However, our duty is to prove and make it a lived experience that this is indeed possible. Otherwise, one should not arrive at the conclusion that it does not exist, that it is non-existent, and that there is no point in anyone striving for it. It is indeed something that can be revealed and seen. Thus, when speaking of the realization of this vision, one must attain the vision of at least one *chaturyuga* (epoch of four ages). How can that be attained? Through whom can we achieve it? It would not be right to dismiss it as non-existent. In this way, various religious theorists, yogic doctrines, and numerous logical rationalizations have been combined by our people, who have said various things both in the past and the present. But they do not explain how this is to be executed. They do not know. In your experience, at least some among you sitting here—we might find at least ten or twenty people—are witnessing exactly how it is. In accordance with the *yugadharma* (duty of the age), what must come to us is the dharma of Kali. It would not be correct to say that this Kali is bad; it is good. If one asks how it can be good, our predecessors have stated it with the Guru as the witness. However, we have not understood what kind of Guru, from which era, or how they should be. Or, even if understood, the knowledge and its accompanying tradition of recitation, when fully articulated, merely become a remnant of alphabetical knowledge. How can this become the truth? How will it become true? Can one say that the karmic course of those past eras does not exist? Not at all. Furthermore, if one simply immerses and halts within the sound of Omkara, the sound 'Om' is heard in our ears for everything. That Omkara resides within us. There is a way for you to make this clear, easily clear. If you submerge in water and close both ears, you will continuously hear a humming sound of 'Om'. This exists in each of us. Therefore, one cannot simply fulfill it by explaining various meanings such as we are Brahma, or Vishnu, or Shiva. That is not the nature of this subject. In this matter, the existence culminates only in the lineage of a Guru who belongs to a karmic path where we have realized at least one *manvantara*. We consider a *manvantara* to be seventy-one *chaturyugas*. Can we complete this? That has never been possible. Nor will it be. Then, our existence is the *yugadharma* that arrives in accordance with time. That *yugadharma* is Kali. One cannot simply say that the dharma of Kali does not exist and move on. In such Kalidharma, across whatever eras you and I have repeatedly manifested, all of it is witnessed in our Guru-disciple relationship. Observing it as waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, one perceives the karma residing within ourselves in such a way that not even a hair's breadth remains to be taken. Not only that, whichever preceptors, whichever prophets, and their followers in the world have come and gone over these twenty-five *chaturyugas*, the erroneous aspects of their times are being corrected. This must happen through you yourselves. It will not be proper if it comes through the Gurus. A medium is created here for that purpose. That is why the term *Gurupooja* was mentioned. Calling it *Gurupooja* is also correct. How is that? By conceptualizing it as *Gurupooja*, envisioning their god, goddess, and ancestors, and by transforming its negative aspects, this life force is altered and stationed somewhere here. *Grihadharma* (the duty of the householder) is the reclamation of the virtuous essence of this life force. To be born into such *grihadharma*, our vision entails recognizing what great souls like these ancestors and the guidance that came through them are, and reclaiming from that. This is only possible when a Guru is present. It is the disciple themselves who perceives what such a Guru is. No one else can see it. It cannot just be taught either. Anyone can say it. Thus, it is not about whether this disciple is male or female, young or old. By showing their own dharma through themselves, pointing out whatever flaws they have, they themselves will see the Guru taking them over. This is the matter at hand. It is not about recounting miracles or great claims of mystical powers. That must not be done. If one proceeds in that manner, how many miracles can be shown to complete this? It will never work. This trinity system known to us, or the ritualistic nature of any religion—how it came about, how it can be implemented by us, and how it was implemented, is something we observe ourselves. After seeing this, they themselves will be fully convinced of what it is, within this disciple. Someone within their own family would have seen it. They are observing how that ancestor stands, how the deity stands, how the sage stands, and if there is anyone else who left as an ascetic, how they stand. Thus, we must cross at least three generations in this manner. Without this, it will not be completed. The reason for this is that one cannot just say that the karma of those living souls spanning so many *chaturyugas* does not exist. That is incorrect. How did that karma exist, and how did errors occur within it? The knowledge referred to as our *Gurupooja* must be a knowledge that corrects this. By correcting it, we are undertaking a dharma capable of attaining liberation for ourselves. This is the true path called *grihadharma*. We have often heard it said before that *grihadharma* is the greatest dharma. But what is accomplished through this *grihadharma* is what remains unknown. That is, we are reclaiming both the good and the bad of our ancestors who have come and gone over countless ages. Having reclaimed it, only the virtuous aspects are retained while the rest perishes. That must proceed within this karma of light itself. If I tell you all this right now, you might not easily grasp it. The reason is that the karmic course depicted in these trinity aspects, or in any other mythological epics, or in any other religious doctrines, stretches to a maximum of four or five thousand years. Or, if stretched further, one can tell stories, but cannot explain how it is to be corrected. So, we must reclaim it. The path of reclaiming it is what we achieve through this *grihadharma*. These steps of dharma, demonstrated and reclaimed through that *grihadharma*, must occur through a father and mother themselves. However, we have not found such parents today. Therefore, we are troubled. Now, this comes to you. Through any of those born after '73, though not in everyone, a portion of it will be fulfilled through each of them. In fulfilling this, they themselves witness the account of their births and deaths. Similarly, for it to be implemented through them, this must be seen in the special luminous form of the Guru. It will not happen simply. No matter how much one summarizes such a form of light, it cannot be articulated with a definitive conclusion or pacifying resolution. It is not like that. It must emerge through ourselves. We do not currently have parents suited for that. They are the children born after '73. For this karma to spread to those children, they themselves must see what the Guru tradition and prophetic tradition—which we have now reconstructed into temple systems and religious systems—truly are. It cannot be executed except through those who perceive this. It is approaching in this manner. Most people have felt that it is true. But crossing it is difficult. For that, our girls, or those we call mother or sister, have not reached that qualification. What about the father? Not at all. Because he was born through this mother. It won't be right. So, if asked what this mother is, we do not even know. For the position of this mother to manifest as the mother herself, there is much exertion required. Some children here have been able to see it. However, no matter what they see, say, or do, they are in a state where they leave it behind without understanding it. The very reason for that is they are people born in the astrological sign worshipped and established by their predecessors. Neither our parents nor our ancestors have the ability to liberate them from it. It is that inability that needs to be recognized by such great souls. Having been able to know this through such a great soul, we are still confused, lacking the knowledge to reclaim it today. How should we correct this? One must descend into the karma of adhering to the dharma seen through the Guru, realizing that it must be reclaimed. Another massive error has occurred among women. You know that. Even today, it exists occasionally in our country. But because it is not obvious, you are unaware of it. We send girls to the Devadasi system. It is currently somewhat detached from Kerala. Although it exists in other states, it is not explicit. This still happens in a temple in Karnataka. The state of affairs is the Devadasi system. So, the souls trapped in all these—how can this be changed? Think for yourselves. When this comes into this vision, these past karmic errors consolidated into action by gods, goddesses, sages, ascetics, and wise ones emerge before you. Must you not take this up and act upon it? What will you do for this? Through whom will it be executed? This is the issue. It cannot be suddenly explained and made understandable to someone. Or, even if you see it, you lack the karmic courage to take it up.

[GV4:P0924] There are quite a few girls sitting right here. They perceive this to be the truth. However, they are unable to grasp it. This is because their life's capacity is not something that can be endured. It is an unbearable capacity. If you were to ask them how these girls came to suffer this unbearable predicament, even they would be unable to explain. Similarly, in the current scenario, there are likely at least fifteen boys present here itself.

[GV4:P0925] This completely reaches a state of knowledge only along with the growth of these children. It may not be in the manner you suggest. You must observe a method for this right now. Suppose you have a five-year-old child in your home. Ascertain whether you possess the intellectual capacity that this child has at merely five years of age. If you observe them in this manner until they are about fifteen years old, you will be able to perceive it. If you look further down, what exists below the age of five is entirely different. Thus, numerous generations have passed by. Its fundamental nature involves the process of rejuvenating the souls born in previous epochs, whose karmic flaws have partially or entirely dissolved. You will not comprehend this immediately. Bringing this forth requires immense foresight from the parents, which is transmitted to these children. In this way, every child initially occupies the position of an impure entity. The mother and father must at least elevate themselves to the process of purifying this entity. Alternatively, at least the child must attain that state. Our approach entails systematically clearing the hierarchical steps of righteousness (dharma) that purify each individual. It is certainly not the knowledge constructed through the theoretical preaching of Vedanta. That knowledge represents an entirely different dimension. I am not suggesting that it does not exist. It is the intellectual knowledge of scholarly assemblies. What has this assembly been capable of achieving until today? Absolutely nothing. Apart from the mere entertainment of reciting and discussing it, nothing of substance is possible. Countless eminent figures, including Gunamkudi Masthan, Naranathu Bhranthan, and the eighteen Siddhars, have pointed out the exact same reality. However, they are unable to articulate how it should be practically executed. That remains the core issue. Therefore, you are receiving this knowledge at this juncture because it aligns with the dharma of Kali Yuga. Within the dharma of this Kali Yuga, our philosophical vision (darshana) represents the practice of eradicating the flaws of the karma performed by our ancestors, deities, and sages who operated from a detached state. That vision must inherently be realized through you yourselves. It is insufficient for the Guru merely to articulate it. What is the reason for this? What benefit do you derive if the Guru claims to have realized it? You must perceive it yourselves. You must recognize it either through the dynamic of the Guru-disciple relationship or through the karma accumulated in your previous incarnations. They must fulfill whatever that entails within the framework of the Guru-disciple relationship. You must embrace the profound dharma bestowed upon you through their children. That represents the trajectory of action intended by the dharma of a householder (Grihadharma). You may have heard this mentioned in various Puranic texts. Yet, how will it be executed? That is the crux of the matter. Consequently, when you bring this endeavor to completion—India is a relatively small nation among countries—it must necessarily be accomplished within India itself. Moreover, it must specifically occur in Kerala. This is because the central axis of India, or perhaps the world, extends downwards from Kanyakumari. Those among you who are educated are aware of this fact. There are numerous regions adjoining that central axis. It is here that its fundamental hymns of origin emerge. Grihadharma is an extraordinary constructive process of adopting those hymns of karma, transforming them into foundational steps of righteousness, turning them into sacred sanctuaries, and cultivating profound love. Through this Grihadharma, you are not meant to wander the globe; rather, God has provided you with the opportunity to take on the very existence of the world and act to harmonize it. You must recognize and undertake this yourselves. At present, it is not visible to everyone. The majority of us were born prior to the aforementioned year of 1973. Or, if born subsequently, the dominant forces are the intellectual subordinates who propagate rationalism and theories of liberation, combined with an array of absurdities. Concurrently, treating education and wealth as mere ornaments, there exist hierarchical steps of karma confined within those parameters. Having fulfilled those steps, they stand at the forefront of this paradigm. How can you possibly take this up? It is completely impossible. Therefore, when such knowledge reaches you, recognize that God has appointed you as His instruments for this specific purpose. Yet, you all presume yourselves to be insignificant, paramount, or something else entirely. Whatever aspects of this they witness, because they are born under the dominion of these deities, they are incapable of complete obedience, of carrying it forward, or of utilizing it to serve others. Such a profound ignorance remains intrinsically attached to our existence. The continuous stream of light known as Guru Dharma is what transforms this condition. The disciple must perceive the true nature of this luminous stream. It is the disciple who must meticulously categorize and integrate this, element by element. The presence of the Guru alone is inadequate. If the Guru alone executes it, it will remain flawed. Thus, this disciple embodies a dharma that remains completely impartial to distinctions of gender, stature, caste, or religion. That constitutes the true magnitude of the disciple. It attains absolute completion when it is offered back to the Guru. As long as you fail to comprehend this, neither you nor I can achieve anything of substance. This is derived from my personal experience. There were numerous followers who stood by me and experienced this reality. Yet, they too committed errors. When corrected, they persistently deviate and ultimately dissolve into obscurity. The underlying issue is that not everyone is capable of bringing it to fruition. Even upon witnessing it, they cannot internalize it. Having observed, understood, and even recognized the absolute purity of its nature, they have still strayed from the path. This constitutes our inherent karmic flaw. Rectifying this flaw is what we all collectively aspire to achieve through our household lives; furthermore, your ultimate objective is to offer this completely to the world through the emerging righteous souls and through householders who maintain unwavering vigilance. That is precisely why, when a marriage is solemnized here, the bride and groom are required to stay at the premises for approximately a week. Some, according to their own volition, choose to remain for a month or even a month and a half. Such profound wisdom is embedded within this practice. God has graciously granted us an era wherein we can reclaim this wisdom through our descendants. It must be noted that this practice is predominantly beneficial for families who have conducted Guru Pooja here and subsequently arrange marriages through this institution, recognizing its inherent value. Conversely, if parents independently arrange a marriage based solely on their personal preferences, the intended purpose will not materialize. What is the underlying reason? The familial environments of the bride and the groom will fundamentally lack compatibility. Even if they temporarily align, they will fail to nurture it with genuine love. They will remain completely entangled in karmic afflictions capable of alienating the bride and groom entirely. What assistance can we offer them? We can do absolutely nothing.

[GV4:P0926] Everyone knows the difficulty of raising a child, whether male or female. In any case, they do not raise them to kill and eat them. They will do various things according to the desires of those who raise them. But it does not materialize. Why ? Because of our previously acquired *karmadosha*, we tend to stray like this. Therefore, it is that very *karmadosha* that made this person refuse to agree. That is an experience in that house itself. This is what we must understand. Can they ever return to that house? You might think that if one possesses education, wealth, and intellect ٹ..!

[GV4:P0927] We are the people whom God has given an opportunity to accomplish this. By guiding each of us towards the aspect called the Guru, reclaiming that *karma* and realizing the *dharma* of the world, imparting it to the children, and putting it into practice, the parents will attain the very position that the child reaches. This is what I have to say.

[GV4:P0930] The fallacies brought about by worship and other aspects

[GV4:P0931] We have an acquaintance that is ignorant of how this Trimurti worship came about, how it will eventually fade, or how it is currently sustained. Over time, lower-level cultures have increased, and for the past three hundred years, this worship has existed in a state of profound ignorance. Our Karunagappally and Karthikappally fall into this category. The story of Ochira is narrated in a similar vein. So, what we have witnessed is the manifestation of the deity and its subsequent transformation. Then comes the aspect of *Siddhi* (special powers). These deities, goddesses, and spirits will suddenly display miraculous tests. We mistakenly assume that these phenomena originate from God. Would God display such things before us? We have heard that because the lineage of Manu took the wrong turn, a curse was pronounced by Brahman back then. Only we believe this; no one else in the world has heard of it. The reason attributed to this is that from the moment this *Chaturvakyam* (four profound utterances) emerged, divine grace was lost. Divine grace means the grace of Brahman. It is not something possessing form or name. The Trimurti system originated after this grace was lost and the *Chaturyuga* remained inactive. When the Trimurti system reached its completion, the fourth face was missing. That is why the very name 'Nanmukhan' (the four-faced one) was lost. Consequently, it is this three-faced system that was finalized. Therefore, the completion of this three-faced system does not belong to the tradition of Manu. It was established as Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva—or as Shaktheyam, Shaivam, and Vaishnavam—and all aspects of good and evil were concealed beneath it. What did you understand? If this befell the Hindus first, it has subsequently affected the entire world. This is precisely what others state as well. Concepts like Adam, Allah, and the Holy Spirit reflect how this has permeated all other religions. However, people remain unaware of this truth. Consider the crores of people practicing this—over a hundred years, countless millions have been absorbed into this system! It has since evolved into various religious doctrines in multitude of ways. Who can truly comprehend this, and how? Can this be understood through Puranas and Epics, or by interpreting the meaning of the Upanishads? How can one grasp this merely by preaching and practicing the essence of the Vedas? Some among you, both men and women, hold such perspectives. But what have you actually understood? Speak for yourselves. I have pointed out this experience among us on numerous occasions. What we term Hinduism today is a lineage where the Trimurti system was reiterated after the *Manusmriti* or the Manu lineage went astray. Furthermore, since we cannot distinguish whether it is Hindu or Sanatana, if we ask the Brahmins, they will claim to be Sanatanis. How can one be a Sanatani while worshipping the Trimurti? It is impossible. Consequently, they perished. Today, those Brahmin families and anyone who followed this Vedic law have met their downfall. Subsequently, many individuals, looking mechanically towards the West and accumulating degree after degree, will travel wherever necessary abroad for employment. In reality, they possess no genuine connection with their families. This is the kind of tradition they have inherited. When did the entire Shudra class assimilate among you?

[GV4:P0932] You cannot say anything about what its realization is, other than saying that we follow the Guru's path, whether you call it Gurupooja or anything else ٹ to tell . This is what happens from Sri Krishna's time until today; apart from making up stories by combining many men and women while talking about Sri Krishna, if asked what you have understood about Sri Krishna, what will you say? Even that is not understood . After this , the knowledge we have received about those who came after Sri Krishna till today is of 2,444 great souls. Their capability has also reached this lineage . So all of them have come together, and their disciples, or everything that came in the nature of their worship, should merge and dissolve into the lineage. How did you understand that? Their liberation. What should you get from it? That soul breaking away all the evil it has acquired till today - this is breaking away through the Guru ٹ in a thousand ways for a thousand people ٹ and for lakhs of people ٹ this is being broken. That light shines, and you are seeing it. It has brought us to the forefront of many karmas. This is for all children as well. Someone might think what they got is right. It is not like that . Then some education or knowledge might have come in the model of a house. I have said many times why this is given through women. If their two generations do not grow , by two generations it means one generation is a hundred and twenty years. Within these a hundred and twenty years, there will be very few like the mother. The rest must be done by their children and their children's children. Should we implement this through them or not? How will that be implemented? Tell me what your knowledge is.

[GV4:P0933] It is in the Trimurti tradition that our worship has been conducted till today , as far as we know. Right? But that is not our system of worship. Manvantaram ٹ That is the 28th Chaturyuga of the seventh Manu after the Manvantaram. In this yuga , to us, in this Manvantaram , it was a mistake made by some Guru . It is a mistake . Not a lack of knowledge . We are uprooting the basis of that mistake . How do we uproot it? Saying a word wrong will cause harm. This lineage of ours will be deprived of it. By lineage, it does not mean everyone will be deprived of it , but at least a few will miss out on it. They are the ones who reject it despite knowing it. Doing this Guru Puja according to our understanding and as guided by God, is to set aside ancestors, deities, and everything like them. This must henceforth be born in your lineage. It should be born as a Guru parampara (lineage of Gurus). And not as a deva parampara (lineage of deities) or any other--like Shaktheya, Shaiva, or Vaishnava --lineage . We are taking hold of all these three. We have taken hold of them. It was on the day we took hold of them that Guruvayur caught fire. After that, we endured great sorrow for six or seven years for it to be fulfilled. It has been about fifteen years since it was fulfilled. After this, apart from the family who performed this Guru Puja, if there is any family entitled to it, not just in our Kerala or India, but anywhere in the world, it ٹ.

[GV4:P0934] This was not obtained for nothing. You are the ones who, at some point in time, desired this in some way of life. Then it faded away. After losing it, you entered into this Trimurti system. It is not something recent. To destroy this entirely, who is there? The Guru. How does the Guru destroy it? You know this is the truth. But you neither desire it in the same way, nor do you accept it. Ancestors from countless crores of past lives have been sent across! About a hundred among those of you who came that day have witnessed it like that. This is what is said to have started from Kanyakumari. I have told you a historical truth regarding this. You do not know how to accept it. Kanyakumari is the place where the equator converges, isn't it? The equator. It begins from Kanyakumari and a central part of the Indian Ocean. Then you learn another name as well. The name of a rock is mentioned there, right? Mainakam. It is from there that this originates. That is why the Gandhi Ghat was placed there. Do you ever think about any of this? Aren't you educated people? If you don't do this, what will you do? From there, our equator passed. It goes towards Germany, doesn't it? It is in this region that the light remains. It has appeared right in the middle of the Indian Ocean. It has emerged in a history where the Bay of Bengal, the Arabian Sea, and the Indian Ocean—all three blend together. Having received this, what have you been able to do? You are the ones who study and teach this history. This history merely provides a subtle sign in the place where such history is being studied. Apart from narrating this history like this, none of us knows anything. The greatness of India remains unknown. People from outside say that they wish to be born in India at least as a blade of grass. Therefore, this land that has attained such immense greatness, especially Kerala. The origin of Kerala is Kanyakumari. It was received there. We have been there and experienced it as well. You remember, don't you? Thus, this is a time ordained for you by God.

[GV4:P0935] The Trimurti system, after this mistake of the Manu lineage, was completed in ten Chaturyugas. Out of that, three Chaturyugas remained inactive. Then it started functioning from the fourth Chaturyuga. Thus, it actually functioned from the seventh Chaturyuga. This Trimurti system was completed in the seventeenth Chaturyuga. Nothing has happened beyond this. Crores of humans have come. The birth of Sree Rama happened for that purpose. It is said that it came about because Vashistha performed the Putrakameshti ritual. It is something that cannot be attained even after striving for crores of births. That is why it is said, 'Yatra yatra Yogeshwara Krishna'. Even those who came like that could not achieve this. This is abundantly available to you. However a human life has been stacked and accumulated, those sins and merits are given to you after being completely destroyed in this light. You must understand that. This is a truth received for your family life or for completing a human life. If you do not understand this truth, you will never get it in another birth. It is just that you do not receive it in the same way. You receive it in a manner akin to the saying 'a thousand ways for a thousand people'. Women should nicely merge their prayers, intentions, knowledge, acquaintance, and all thoughts and emotions into those lotus feet and shouldn't you have at least a thought that you are being saved from it? Isn't that what you need? All the flaws of these women are removed, and if they have a husband, wife, and children, through their intentions and prayers, Narayana Guru says thus: 'Bharya Bhajati Bhartaram'. Even if the husband becomes ignorant, through the knowledge of this wife, he will at least attain moksha. And not mukti. This is how it is stated. So, even after so many of you have seen it, honoring that, shouldn't you have at least the knowledge that 'for my house, for my children, for my husband'? Knowing that, shouldn't you explain this to your children saying, 'Children, this is the greatest in the world, the first karma' ٹ You should explain and make them understand this.

[GV4:P0936] You, who have this much knowledge, must think about how you should receive this. In the realm of knowledge, it is a traditional path that equally accepts the rights and wrongs of human life. This is the first of its kind in the world. Shouldn't you have the wisdom to respect and accept it? There is no one ready to take this up. My body - even lying down like this, I am speaking. What should each of you do? These people standing near me right now, each one of them, if they are like this, then what can I do? Realizing it as a memory, you must understand and act according to your knowledge as needed. This should traditionally reach the world as your acquired karma. You must understand and act accordingly. What can I do? I am not putting on any pretense before you. You would have shown greater respect than this. I know a trick. Do you know what it is? Forcefully pushing it upon you. And then lining up ten or a hundred people, praising them as 'he' and 'him' and parading them around, just ordinary people. Hearing this, you would tremble and accept it. But that is deceit. Nothing can be gained through that deceit. What can be done if those without devotion are caught in this blindness? So, this is entirely a provision given to you by God. If you harbor jealousy, darkness, or ignorance towards this, the same will happen to your entire household. We do not belong to any caste or religion. This holds the highest and most formidable position in the human world. You should understand and do this. You must know this. Grieving with our minds, whatever needs to exist in this world is bestowed upon us through that supreme cosmic power. What should we do? I do not know, dear. You must submit this request and take it up. Otherwise, there is no point in us merely repeating this as a model.

[GV4:P0937] If our boys are not capable of taking this up, it is to be attained through women. Women must fully reflect that image of the primordial mother. The coming generationٹ from them, along with their husbands and children, are meant for serving the world. For this, you must see one thing: whatever exists in the world will be shown. Then each of the spheres will be shown. In a way that proves that the Guru stands with you, or else, Asan says like this, "He sees without eyes, hears without ears" -- this is the part which says that. Kumaran Asan says this. Then for that characteristic, many ways have been mentioned. Such a person walks devoid of illusions and desires, as an Atmayogi. These illusions and deceptions are of no consequence to him. What else? Like a madman. What is madness? Craziness. Being mad means those who lack sense in their heads. Like a madman, like an absolute simpleton - like someone who knows nothing, walking devoid of illusions, desires, and magic, an Atmayogi - this is what Asan said. That is the practice of an Avadhuta. But it is fulfilled exactly as you see it. So wherever the Guru's light exists, in that light, this path of karma, as a mother, where do you take it -- that is what is seen. GURUVANIKAL · October 2003 · Volume 4

[GV4:P0942] October 2003

[GV4:P0943] I have visited on numerous occasions. Each time, I would come as far as Olassery and then return. I had not ventured into other nearby localities, having visited merely two or four places. Never before have I come here during this summer season. I was told that this is a remarkable place. Somehow, a synthesis of the land's ancient and modern knowledge has merged here. However, we have not been able to assimilate it in the proper manner, nor have we had the opportunity to do so. If one asks whether it is better elsewhere, the answer is no. The reason for this lies in our archaic knowledge and familiarities—what constitutes the distinction between the lineage of the Trimurti and that of Manu, what Manu represents, and how Manu came to be. We have not been corrected or enlightened regarding such profound knowledge. There is another reason to state for this. We acquire complete knowledge of the divine will only from certain transcendent Gurus of different eras and their contemporary counterparts. However, the prevailing understanding is that this knowledge slipped from our grasp approximately twenty-five *Chaturyugas* ago. This cannot be comprehended through the words of ordinary mortals, nor can it be realized through the words of deities. I acquired this knowledge much like one learns through an unforeseen ordeal. If you ask how, we once possessed a certain knowledge—a knowledge belonging to the lineage of the Trimurti. Customarily, it elaborates on the aspects of *Parashakti* and then concludes there. Or, to express it in a slightly more refined manner, we have only witnessed the practice of narrating the tale of Devendra and then casually dismissing it as the divine play of the Lord. In all those instances, we are presented with acts that merely evoke astonishment. We are left with no choice but to blindly believe. Why? Because we were unaware of where the error lay and where it required correction. I indicated to you earlier that this was realized through being caught in such a misconception. This so-called misconception is evident in the fact that we observe a deeply entrenched familiarity with vehemently worshipping actions up to the stature of the Trimurti. Yet, this essentially halts with forceful narrations of the heavenly realms. To reconcile this, we are appeased with descriptions of the 'netherworld' (*Pathala*), accompanied by its specific attributes. When patched together with aspects of the dharma of *Kali Yuga*, it never truly aligns logically. As they narrate this, we are taught and made to recite tales of realms that could merely be rationalized as the other side of our earth. Nevertheless, this does not elevate us to a genuine state of profound knowledge. It fails to transcend the boundaries of a merely geographically expansive understanding. The reason it fails to transcend is because it is a narrative constructed by referencing the positions of Devendra and Parashakti, and writing further based solely upon them. It neither progresses beyond that point, nor is it possible to even reach thus far. Subsequently, this is how we perceive it. We note that certain *Puranas* delineate transitional states of existence. However, they have been unable to conclusively explain them. What does this mean? When we speak of a transitional state, it is essentially a vision or revelation. The definitive conclusion of this vision is stated precisely in terms of seven thousand, seven thousand four hundred and forty-four, and so on—incrementing by seventy to reach seventy thousand seven hundred and forty-three. Consequently, this implies that such a multitude of transitional states exist within a specialized framework of completion. How can we demonstrate this? In what manner can it be articulated? However, this vision is exceedingly rare for an ordinary human to attain. Even if attained, we are scarcely permitted to fully immerse ourselves in it. The reason is that Gurus who have transcended this fourth state are exceedingly rare. The designation of *Hamsa* has been appended—many Gurus are referenced with this title—yet we have not been informed of the various categories of this *Hamsa* state. Everything is simply stated by attaching the term *Hamsa*. To summarize this *Hamsa* state, once we began discussing it, it was postulated that, if necessary, all animals serve as the vehicles for these incarnate beings. How many can realistically believe this? Similarly, we remain stagnated at a point where we are merely told of the vehicle of Subrahmanya or the vehicle of Garuda. This is a domain where they have meticulously managed the convergence of the material and the spiritual. Yet, upon reaching that juncture, they find themselves with nothing substantive to impart. This is my personal experience. The reason they lack anything to impart is that some of us have heard up to what extent this status of Devendra reaches, though not everyone has. The entity known as Devendra is one who has surpassed this status of *Deva*. If it is concluded with the tale of a *Yaksha*, and we are told this is not it, we would fail to comprehend it. Because we have neither witnessed it, nor has it been explained to us. And if asked what has been explained, we remain ignorant of that as well. It is only after being trapped and wandering for an immeasurable epoch in the deeds where the *Puranas* and epics ultimately culminated, that we are finally granted an opportunity to emerge from it. Regarding this, the epochs articulated by the author of the *Gita* are indeed the accurate ones.

[GV4:P0944] In that position referred to as 'Kali Shudrankal' (Kali in the Shudra), it is the Shudra class. When we speak of the Shudra class, in our Kerala itself, it has been divided into seventy-four castes. These seventy-four castes, when they reach North India, transform into more than a hundred. We cannot even imagine where this sense of dharma—which subsequently turned caste into a deity and rendered it devoid of karma—will take us, how it will culminate, and how we will be able to proceed. The reality is that no Purana, Itihasa (epic), or Shastra has emerged to explain how we should overcome such karmic defects. Why did it not emerge? It is because of not acting with the knowledge of the times (Yugas). When we speak of times, we are thinking about the four epochs: Satyayuga or Kritayuga, Tretayuga, Dwapara, and Kali. We have arrived at the point where the author of the Gita has stated 'Kali Shudrankal'. Thus, standing here, like those who are unable to comprehend the interpretation concerning us without a completely theoretical knowledge or without learning a language, which guru—who is the guru of these times, why are the primordial gurus mentioned in this way to merely gloss over things, who should come as the followers of this guru, in which lineage should it culminate, which part should it reach—this is what we do not know. So, what is the dharma of Kali? We ourselves must observe the rights and wrongs that have occurred up to this day. Having seen that, we should fulfill it within the dharma of Kali. It is not about running away and abandoning Kali. We have been made to believe that the dharma of Kali is entirely evil. Because Kali has been depicted as a defect in this manner, we do not become thinkers in every way. Then, one should not think about it. It is said what state is achieved in that experience by placing atomic science in it through an atmospheric revolution. But beyond that, no one can do anything there. [GV4:P0961] January 2004

[GV4:P0962] In this concept referred to as Manvantara, the matter of Brahma is not evident. It is only in the seventh Manvantara that the concept of Brahma is observed. You might even question whether God is unaware of why such a concept arose. Whenever a kingdom or a position is conferred, when that position is assumed, it is taken up in accordance with the respective era. Our ancestors lacked the experience to assume this position. If dharma in accordance with the times is not enforced, it will result in a flaw within this evolutionary theory. Therefore, it was introduced without allowing such an error. However, this is perceived only up to the heavenly realms by certain seers and a few other individuals. The reality of the rest is different. It ultimately comes down to the calculations of a solar system. It will have to be articulated how many Brahmas exist for the solar system, what their nature is, what they are, and why they came into being. Living a life devoid of this knowledge, or when the greatest scholar rewrites following the texts written until then, and attains success to the extent of their fortune, it is reduced to mere literal interpretation. Consequently, the meaning of the word changes. When it changes in this manner, numerous kinds of confusions arise among us. Readers of the Ramayana will exaggerate and state it emphatically. How so? 'Ra' must change. When asked what that implies, they assert that likes and dislikes (*Raga-Dvesha*) must change. Most people fail to consider whether altering these likes and dislikes is something anyone can practically achieve while alive. Then emerges the theory of scholars who chase after the poetic imagination which dictates that until 'Ra' changes, 'Ma' cannot be grasped. In order to demonstrate who was the greater scholar in the royal court of their respective times, if scholars competitively wrote and recited their works, the king did not necessarily need to comprehend south, north, east, or west. He merely needed to endorse it. The scholars have thus documented that all these accomplishments were brought about during this particular ruler's reign. With that, the matter was deemed settled.

[GV4:P0963] Many such instances have occurred among us. Maha Vishnu, who trampled righteous rulers down to the netherworld (*Patala*) under the pretext that they lacked absolute decorum, was born here. If one asks why he was trampled into the netherworld in this manner, it is because he was classified as an Asura there. Thus, because he happened to be an Asura emperor, they instituted their law stipulating that he was not permitted to rule. Therefore, to establish that a Brahmin rules during that Sudra era within the Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Sudra systemic framework according to their laws, this individual had to be eliminated by fabricating a narrative about the emperor. However, the story propagated is highly illogical. Three paces of land were requested; when that was deemed insufficient, his head was also trampled down. You need not harbor any doubt that this is merely the logic of a poet. Just as it is narrated regarding Brahma, so too about Narada, or concerning numerous Brahmarakshasas, or in the accounts of countless angels, or certain celestial beings and the so-called djinns; by presenting various such accounts and leading humanity astray through literal interpretations, divine will must inevitably intervene at some point. Otherwise, by miscalculating the Manvantaras, it will be impossible to usher in a new Manvantara. Therefore, a resolution is only possible if a wealth of preceptorship (*Acharya Sampath*) emerges, capable of conveying to the people what must be contributed to the Manvantara and explaining why errors occurred within it.

[GV4:P0964] The subsequent thought is regarding what kind of person that Acharya (preceptor) should be. This cannot be altered by an ordinary path of a Guru, or a path of renunciation (Sanyasa), or a minor prophetic path. Only someone who possesses a long-term vision spanning the duration of a Manvantara can change it. Such a long-term vision means understanding the past—how, after six Manvantaras, this came to be in the seventh Manvantara, where its cause lies, and what the reason behind that cause is; only a Mahatma capable of explaining this can set it right. This is because it is a mistake that occurred when a great soul of this Manvantara did the right thing. The fact is that there were no experienced individuals to hand over to us the perfect path of how to perform the right action. Speaking of experienced ones, there are modes of worship ranging from a deity and a demon up to numerous Brahmarakshasas. What has happened in the mode of worship, who all are involved in it, and if there is a duty to grant them birth or liberation by reaching their level in the matter of their existence, the Acharya can move forward only after fulfilling that. This is something that not many can achieve. However, reaching the position of what is called the virtue of the soul (Atmasukrutham)—of gods and goddesses—is also Atmasukrutham itself. After that, what are the positions of the Ganas, and what all Ganas are there—reaching their position is also possible only through Atmasukrutham. But beyond this, there is another state. When all these beings reach their respective places, they attain a celestial realm (Akashamandalam) commensurate with their position, according to their knowledge. That celestial realm, whether they call it the vast expanse (Vettaveli) or as mentioned in the verses of the Ishavasya Upanishad, extends even from such a pinnacle. It is not known how or in what manner one should be guided to that pinnacle. In this, when each demon and each deity appears, one must explain what was initially available for worship in the lineage of the primordial Manu (Aadimanuvu). After explaining that and accustoming them to it, corrections should be made at the stage involving gods, goddesses, sages (Rishis), and ascetics (Sanyasis). A disciple must grow to that level after this correction. There is a possibility that it could be a male or a female. What is that male and female? There are two divisions in that as well. If the male and female stand bound together, masculinity cannot be imparted to the female. For that, they themselves state a name—Napumsakam (gender-neutral). It cannot be given in that state either. Then, how many are the states of the Goddess, how many states exist from this demon to the deity, what are the transitional steps one passes through, and what that karma is—showing these to a disciple and having that disciple impart it to the higher realms of this world is the true aspect. Instead of that, if we go back to the written concepts of Manvantara and try to bring back the original nature of Manu, how do we correct the false narratives that portrayed him as the son of Brahma? Where is the Vedic knowledge located to reclaim the lineage of Manu alongside the lineage of the Trimurti? When viewed this way, numerous things will have to be corrected and rewritten. But this will not happen in one lifetime or even ten lifetimes. Then what is the use of setting out to do it? It is impossible. Then, based on what was seen, they bundled it up and created texts, created letters for the text, and created interpretations for the letters. Thus, assigning sound, form, and shape, they will arrive at an action embellished with ornaments in every note. This embellished action is what we artists call a musical concert. That is an ornamentation. The task is to assign sound, give form to that sound, merge into that form, give meaning to the sound that emerges from it—from within—and study it. Well, if all this could lead us to God, we would not have any other afflictions. It is our Mahatmas themselves who have proven that none of this is what is required. For that, many Gurus from the Parayi Petta Panthirukulam (the twelve clans born to the Pariah woman) and those raised in the Brahmin clan will write down the logic of the Brahmin. Those born in the clan of Shaivites will write down that Shaivism is everything. Otherwise, if one is a Shaktheyan, that is everything for them. These interpreters of letters have brought us to a point where we cannot know which is greater or which is smaller. We have become so corrupted that we are unable to show any sincerity of our own to move away from this. It is not our fault. We flowed along in a course of karma that respected the obstacles encountered along the path of passing times, without analyzing what those obstacles were. It will not be possible in one or two generations to correct this, rewrite it, and convince the people about the actual paths traversed by numerous figures who commonly appear among us now, such as Agastya, Bhogar, or others like Bhishma. People will repeatedly cling to the old and forget the story of the new again. This is a habituation we have been undergoing for so many ages.

[GV4:P0981] Therefore, having understood this, you must perform *Guru Puja* to the best of your abilities—achieving purity of the deities (*deva shuddhi*), sages (*rishi shuddhi*), and ancestors (*pitru shuddhi*)—as this Guru lineage transforms and brings about a paradigm shift in the traditional methods of worship that have existed hitherto. There is no trace of the path of any other previously existing Guru lineages in this. Neither does it contain the path of any other preceptor (*acharya*). This is an independent endeavor that absorbs the entirety of the objectives of the preceptors up to this point, transfers all these rituals into our midst, and ensures that these children or that lineage become instrumental in a manner beneficial to the knowers of Brahman (*Brahmajnanis*). This is the underlying vision. In alignment with this vision, even if only mentally, you should invoke God, or if all of you are physically able and willing, everyone should go and circumambulate the place of worship to the right and chant the continuous divine name (*akhandanama*) for a while. Everyone should chant internally. Having informed that everyone must do this: on one hand, there are ritualistic injunctions that are unbearably burdensome. On the other hand, there is a situation where there is absolutely no one to properly explain the practices that can be adopted. Thus, after the *Yuga Dharmas* (duties of the epochs) themselves have passed in myriad ways, the epoch that provides us with the correction for all this, affording us an opportunity to act by recognizing the mistakes or validities that occurred in all previous epochs—the *Satyayuga*, *Tretayuga*, and *Dvaparayuga*—is the *Kaliyuga*. However, we have been conditioned to believe that this *Kaliyuga* is worthless. Since *Kali* is considered worthless, there are those who even think there is no point in paying much attention to it. We must not evaluate it as worthless. By critically examining the rights and wrongs that have occurred up to this day concerning *Kali*, this *Kaliyuga* serves as a preparatory phase that imparts the knowledge of what must and must not be done to usher the departure toward the next *Satyayuga* into the midst of the masses. We require an awareness of such a *Kaliyuga*, where we are informed even of the errors and granted the opportunity to rectify them. Otherwise, our experience is one of clinging to some mythologies or epics in some way, wasting our lives without any attainment in this field of action, and living a life discarding action, oblivious to its true nature. Why is this so?

[GV4:P0982] The advent of an enlightened being (*jnani*) like Sri Krishna shortly before the commencement of this *Kali* is the greatest testament for this *Shudra* class. Because, prior to that, there was a time when kings ruled as our spiritual preceptors (*Desikas*). Consequently, in accordance with the *dharma* of that epoch, as the author of the Gita states, "Pratyakshavagamam dharmam" (dharma directly experienced), these kings would stand manifest and instruct upon each of these dharmas. However, moving forward from the era of Sri Krishna, that divine resolve (*Brahmanischaya*) had been prepared for us long before, sending many individuals in multiple phases. We failed to discover this within the dharma of our India. The reason for this is our karmic trajectory, wherein we cling to obsolete customs and act upon them, rather than rectifying and internalizing the worship practices of the aforementioned four epochs (*Chaturyugas*). Although it continued in that manner until Sri Krishna's birth, it is said that an ethereal voice (*ashariri*) was given to Kamsa even before the birth. Yet, the greatness of this ethereal voice was never articulated or grasped. What happened as a result? Kamsa was portrayed and presented in a way that makes us declare him evil. But Kamsa was not evil: How? He was merely abiding by his own *dharma*. What was the nature of that *dharma*? This directly perceivable *dharma*, where gods and goddesses manifest and instruct on what must and must not be done, constitutes that matter. So, under these circumstances, upon receiving this ethereal voice, it becomes unbelievable. This is because none of the knowledge of the past ancestors aligns with the dictates of this ethereal voice. So, what does this ethereal voice proclaim? "Rule by looking downwards, not upwards." Since this system of governance did not operate in a single language, the tragedy wherein individuals governed and facilitated governance according to their own convenience in numerous languages across India—lacking the ability to comprehend and act according to the *Yuga Dharmas*, or a situation where the king attains a sage-like status but fails to transmit that wisdom back to the populace—has been persisting across numerous cycles of *Chaturyugas*.

[GV4:P0983] But with the determination to resolve this, this mistake ending, and at the same time people coming together and growing to become knowing what the dharma of the next Satyayuga is, it was to transform into such people that Sri Krishna was made to take birth. But Sri Krishna was born a Jnani (wise one) from birth itself. But this action of being a born Jnani remained unknown to this Shudra class. Now, when saying Shudra class, you might assume it is a caste; it is not a caste. It is a Varna. We all belong to the Shudra class. A prescribed karma is arranged here regarding how a Kshatriya, Vaishya, and Shudra should behave. But converting all those karmas as each one's own entitlement, that karma went on in a way that Dharma could not sustain. We got caught in a trap where it could never be practiced, and each of us moved behind those scrambling to copy the baseness that shows the pride of inter-yuga dharma. What happened to us because of this? We lack self-knowledge. We did not know that we went towards information where others' knowledge destroys us ourselves. Then again from the time of Sri Krishna, ٹ despite Sri Krishna being such a great person, the status attained by that birth, unable to cross over from it due to the ignorance of our people, for a long time, ڊ that acquaintance from the day of birth - is a news of sorrow. Because, the royal family had the misfortune of having to beat to death all seven babies born before him. So, do not rule by looking at emperors, do not rule by looking at past kings either, look at what your Dharma is today - that is what the Ashariri meant. But since this was not a familiar subject as far as Kamsa was concerned, he maintained the scenario that was heard and made to be heard from these gods and goddesses. [GV4:P0984] Can we proceed by speaking a truth that belonged to the Satya Yuga? This is the Kali Yuga. [GV4:P0992] I mentioned a few things about the greatness of sacrifice last time. However, what I have to say does not end with that. [GV4:P0993] No matter how agonizing the problems I faced were, I attempted to resolve them while maintaining utmost equanimity. As a result, my problems were resolved. [GV4:P0997] Then there is another side to it. Let it be said that it is somewhat spiritual. It concerns the course of our karma. One group of people strives in a state where the karmas or sacrifices performed in past lives are eager for completion. Consequently, they achieve results very quickly. For others, the course of karma may not have been completed in their previous lives. There, this course of karma can only be fulfilled through sacrifice. If we consider the reason for someone rising to great heights, it is because that person's current life is destined for it. They might have completed all its aspects by making sacrifices in their past lives. For such individuals, only a little effort is required to achieve their goals. [GV4:P0998] The courses of karma across lifetimes manifest in various ways. Many do not seem to believe in this. Are they not the resurrections of the cursed aspects of past lives? How can we choose not to believe these things? Thus, it follows that the base actions and good deeds of past lives continue to follow us. There are many reasons why we emphasize this, and it is certainly something others should ponder.

[GV4:P0999] Now, let me say a little about the general life of human beings!

[GV4:P1000] When a human being becomes sorrowful, forgetting everything, he wanders in search of refuge. In prosperity, he forgets everything. That is a general characteristic. [GV4:P1001] All the great sacrificers the world has seen today are those who have worked incessantly, standing behind that power. We can all clearly understand what they have achieved as a result. [GV4:P1011] Each of us needs this qualification. Our children absolutely need it. We are completely ignorant about what we must do to achieve this.
